G=load(); print(sorted(G))

import json
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import defaultdict
    colmap={}
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            v=g[r][c]
            if v:
                colmap.setdefault((c-r),set()).add(v)
    ks=sorted(colmap)
    # smallest period p with no color conflicts
    def ok(p):
        m={}
        for k in ks:
            res=k%p
            for v in colmap[k]:
                if res in m and m[res]!=v: return None
                m[res]=v
        return m
    p=1
    while True:
        m=ok(p)
        if m: break
        p+=1
    return [[m[(c-r)%p] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
